body.title: Split oversized diff evidence into lossless bounded review units
body.reproduction: On connection-management Story S003, request insrc_code_review_step with epicHash 484fcef7efaf229e, storyId s3, and diff-based fallback after the two inventory JSON files remain stale. At the default review.chunkTokens=128000, the daemon fails before recording a review: the connection-management-inventory.json atom requires 443605 characters versus384000 allowed. Temporarily raising the supported limit to200000 tokens/600000 characters moves failure to session-source-inventory.json, whose atom requires1838027 characters. The original128000 setting was restored. Expected: review all changed evidence through bounded complete units and record an independent degraded review; oversized indivisible values may still fail explicitly. Actual: no independent review artifact can be produced, blocking S003 completion. Exact errors and restored setting are recorded in the S003 review-blocker evidence [c3].
body.rootCause: The graph locates buildDiffSymbols in src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts and its caller assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding [c1]. Direct source inspection shows one synthetic file symbol carrying a file's unified-diff hunks as its signature, so a large non-code JSON file remains one review item. The shared packIntoBatches correctly raises AtomTooLargeError when one item's complete prompt exceeds the per-call budget [c2]. Increasing the budget does not solve the inappropriate whole-file granularity for the actual1.8M-character item. Graph relationship coverage is incomplete (154 source-missing relationships), so caller exhaustiveness is not claimed; direct search confirms the constructor's production caller and existing diff-grounding test coverage.
body.fixIntent: Allow complete oversized diff evidence to be reviewed as bounded, attributable units while retaining every changed entry and the file/line relationships needed for findings. Preserve the configured per-call limit and reject genuinely indivisible oversized material; do not truncate evidence to obtain a verdict. Preserve degraded coverage reporting and the daemon's independent-review role for controller-authored changes. Keep the S003 inventory contents and disabled release gate intact. Cover large added/modified/deleted JSON evidence and source attribution with focused regressions, then retry the actual S003 review at the restored default budget. This record defines correction intent; detailed unit boundaries and compatibility belong in the sized bugfix design.
